description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage team building AI-powered software for supply chain connectivity. You will help develop purpose-built coding agents and the infrastructure that hosts and runs mission-critical integrations.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build specialized AI coding agents for supply chain integrations.

 - Develop and maintain the platform infrastructure and runtime for hosting integrations.

 - Own core systems end-to-end, from the agent platform through integration execution.

 - Make foundational architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns as the team grows.

 - Work across agent development, backend systems, and cloud infrastructure.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to five years of experience as a full-stack or backend software engineer.

 - Proficiency in TypeScript and modern full-stack development; experience with React, Bun, Effect-TS, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, or AWS is relevant.

 - Experience building backend or infrastructure systems, such as runtimes, orchestration platforms, or cloud services.

 - Hands-on experience building with AI agents or large language models using current approaches.

 - A track record of shipping and owning complex products end-to-end, working autonomously, and building from scratch.

 - Experience in an early-stage, venture-backed startup environment and strong software engineering fundamentals.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $150,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California.
